edbDesc: The change in the modulus of elaticity (i.e. Young's Modulus) of a material as a result of magnetisation. Also used to refer to the reverse efect, i.e. the change in magnetism resulting from elastic tension.
title: Delta-E Effect
pickWhy: The stiffness change comes from the same domain stretching that causes magnetostriction (its use in shop anti-theft tags rides on that); Magnetostriction is the canonical card, in another batch.
